claim: LLMs lack an intrinsic notion of healthy versus abnormal states, requiring explicit thresholds or statistical baselines to guide reasoning.
falsifier: Present LLMs with system metrics from healthy and abnormal states without any threshold hints and measure classification accuracy; compare to performance with explicit thresholds.

conditions: when applied to system monitoring tasks without explicit thresholds or baselines
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Intrinsic knowledge of healthy–ability to distinguish healthy principle
